items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, private-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate or advertising expansion, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep external outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: upstream terms do not establish rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize data; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; analytics quality is yellow; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable; accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any rights-dependent monetization or launch decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Recorded progress includes official API, public terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and private-gate evidence; none establishes launch permission or complete processing evidence. No task is closable. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and blocked for launch. The stated source, purpose, processing, public display, historical derivatives, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising use are not supported by current rights evidence. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed: missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed: missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed: missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
